Definition: to arrange as a battle, a vineyard (to hoe); hence, to muster and so to miss (or find wanting)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to help; 1a) (Qal) to help; 2) to hoe; 2a) (Niphal) to be hoed; 3) to be lacking, fail; 3a)(Niphal); 3b1) to be lacking; 3b1) to leave lacking; 3b) (Piel) to leave lacking
